name: Execution Testbed
principle: Run the same Execution Engine code with injected deterministic dependencies; never fork a test engine.
production_guard: The production manifest forbids testkit dependencies; offline source-dependency checks enforce that execution-engine and provider code do not import execution-testkit. No production environment loader exists yet.
implementation_status: Deterministic primitives, component/composition harnesses and caller-supplied scenario/mass drivers are implemented. Complete engine and replay/shadow runners are not yet implemented.
